title: MuninAI: A Self-Hosted Agentic Framework for Independent Research Groups
abstract: arXiv:2610.23480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research groups that want a language model grounded in their own literature face a choice between hosted services that receive their unpublished work and self-hosted deployments that keep the data local but give the model no access to the corpus. Munin is an open-source framework for a self-hosted scientific assistant that indexes a group's corpus and its citation graph, and wraps whichever open-weight model the group can serve in an agent harness with specialised reading, search, and computation tools. We claim that the harness, rather than the specific model, is what makes the system useful on domain literature, and we ship the evaluation suite that tests this claim with the software.   On 199 paired literature questions, the harness more than doubles the accuracy of the base model, from 0.387 to 0.874 (+0.487, 95% CI [0.407, 0.568]), while naive retrieve-then-answer scores below the unaided model on every backbone tested. tldr: Munin是一个开源的自托管智能体框架，通过为本地部署的开放权重模型配备专门的阅读、搜索和计算工具，将其在领域文献问答上的准确率从0.387大幅提升至0.874，证明了智能体框架本身而非特定模型是系统效用的关键，同时保障了研究小组数据完全本地化。
en_tdlr: Munin is an open-source self-hosted agentic framework that more than doubles open-weight models' accuracy on domain literature questions (from 0.387 to 0.874) by wrapping them in an agent harness with specialized reading, search, and computation tools, demonstrating that the harness—not the specific model—drives the system's usefulness while keeping all research data local.
